w10_T4_005709: A scout troop began a building project with 98 wooden planks. 28 of the planks were too rotten to use and were burned. Each good plank was sawn into 3 short pieces. The troop used 53 pieces for a bench and 45 pieces for a bridge over the stream. Another 81 pieces were carried off for the campfire. How many pieces of wood does the troop have left?
w10_T4_005713: Marcus grows strawberries in 7 polytunnels, and each tunnel produced 217 punnets this June. He sold 994 punnets at the farmers market. A second picking then made the number of punnets he still had 2 times as large. A neighbour handed him 30 punnets that she could not sell. Marcus finished the month holding more punnets than his neighbour Bea did. How many punnets does Marcus have?
w10_T4_005720: A city recycling depot receives 224 sacks of cardboard from each of its 6 districts. Every sack holds 9 bundles, each bundle holds 4 packs, and each pack holds 7 flattened sheets. A school then delivered 80 loose sheets to the depot. During the week 188047 sheets were sent on to the paper mill. The depot runs a dozen collection lorries and employs 35 people. How many sheets of cardboard are left at the depot?
w10_T4_005725: A charity shop had 151 books on its shelves at the start of the week. 76 books were sold, and a house clearance then brought in 32 more. A weekend donation drive doubled the number of books in the shop. A local school added 73 further books to the shelves. The manager slipped 3 leaflets into every book in the shop, and each leaflet carries 9 discount coupons. How many coupons are inside the shop's books?
w10_T4_005731: A theatre counts its takings in cents and announces them in dollars only at the end of the run. On Monday morning the box office had 137 ticket booklets, and by lunchtime a delivery had made the number of booklets 2 times as large. In the afternoon the printer sent 62 more booklets. Each booklet holds 4 sheets, and every sheet holds 5 tickets. In the evening all of those tickets were sold for 4 cents each at the children's matinee. Dario sold more of them that evening than his colleague Ruth did. How many cents did the theatre take?
w10_T4_005733: On Monday morning a corner shop had 89 loaves of bread on its shelf. Before noon a hostel bought 83 of them. In the early afternoon 5 more loaves were sold to a passer-by. A delivery in the evening put 12 fresh loaves on the same shelf. Just before closing a restaurant took 11 loaves. The shop opens 6 days a week. How many loaves are on the shelf now?
w10_T4_005736: A council depot measures its grit in kilograms although the lorry gauges read in tonnes. The depot began the winter with 156 sacks of grit, and 11 sacks had split open and were thrown away. Each remaining sack was tipped into 4 bins. A neighbouring town then sent 42 more bins of grit. During January 424 bins were emptied onto the roads. Each bin still at the depot holds 6 kilograms of grit, and the depot runs 9 lorries. How many kilograms of grit are at the depot?
w10_T4_005740: On Saturday morning a bakery made 164 cupcakes and shared them equally among its 4 market stalls. Anya took the cupcakes for the stall on the square. At midday the bakery sent her 29 more cupcakes, and in the early afternoon a helper carried over 19 more. In the evening a second bake added 78 cupcakes to Anya's stall. Anya received more cupcakes that day than her colleague Pavel did at his stall. How many cupcakes are on Anya's stall now?
w10_T4_005743: A fruit farm picked 85 crates of plums from each of its 9 orchards. Every crate holds 6 baskets, and a helper found 11 extra baskets of plums in the barn. Each basket is packed with 2 layers of fruit, and every layer holds 7 plums. The farm shop has 4 checkouts. How many plums did the farm pack in all?
w10_T4_005744: A youth club records its hall bookings in minutes and puts them on the noticeboard in hours. At the start of term the club held 119 minutes of hall time, and a grant added 34 minutes. A drama group then used 76 minutes, a choir used 40 minutes and a judo class used 29 minutes. The caretaker gave the club 11 extra minutes at the end of one evening. A final rehearsal used 7 minutes. A dozen spare chairs are stacked at the back of the hall. How many minutes of hall time does the club have left?
w10_T4_005747: A grain merchant weighs everything in kilograms although his sacks are still stamped in pounds. On Monday morning 170 sacks were shared equally among the merchant's 5 vans. In the afternoon the driver of one van unloaded 18 sacks at a stable. Each sack still on that van holds 7 kilograms of grain. In the evening a farmer poured 15 more kilograms loose into the back of the same van. How many kilograms of grain are on that van?
w10_T4_005750: A cinema had 198 tubs of popcorn ready before the evening show, and the kitchen made 7 more. During the film 187 tubs were sold at the counter. A school group then took 8 tubs, and the staff kept 2 tubs for themselves. A dozen film posters hang in the foyer. How many tubs of popcorn are left?
w10_T4_005755: On Monday morning a market trader had 126 bags of apples in his lorry, and by lunchtime a farm had added 7 more bags and then 23 more. In the afternoon he shared all of the bags equally among the 6 shops on his round, and the shop on Hill Street took its share. Every bag delivered to that shop holds 9 apples. In the evening the shopkeeper added 19 loose apples from her own garden. Each apple in her shop is priced at 9 cents. How many cents are all of that shop's apples worth?
w10_T4_005757: On Monday morning a warehouse held 230 pallets of tinned soup, and 65 pallets were shipped out before noon. Each pallet still in the warehouse carries 7 cases, every case holds 4 boxes, and every box holds 6 tins. By the evening the manager Klara had counted the whole stock, and it came to more tins than her colleague Tomas found in the smaller depot. How many tins are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_005758: A bead workshop began with 94 tubs of beads. Each tub was emptied into 3 jars, and every jar was tipped into 2 pouches. The pouches were shared equally among the workshop's 3 tables, and the tutor sat at one of them. Each pouch on the tutor's table was opened into 2 dishes, and every dish holds 4 beads. A child then dropped 4 loose beads onto that table. The workshop lasts 90 minutes. How many beads are on the tutor's table?
w10_T4_005764: A city car park records its takings in cents and banks them in dollars. On Monday there were 197 parking cards in the machine, and an attendant loaded 57 more. Each card is worth 5 tokens, and 842 tokens were used by drivers that week. A delivery firm then handed back 79 unused tokens. Every token the car park still holds is worth 5 cents, and 665 cents were paid out in refunds. Hasan handled more tokens that week than his colleague Mira did, and the car park has 300 spaces. How many cents does the car park hold?
w10_T4_005771: A community radio station logs its airtime in minutes and prints the schedule in hours. Dev's programme slot began the month at 60 minutes. The manager added 28 minutes to the slot, then took 40 minutes away for a news bulletin. A sponsor bought 15 more minutes for the same slot, but 27 minutes were later given to a sports show and 17 minutes to a music hour. Dev's slot is still longer than his colleague Anita's slot. How many minutes long is Dev's slot now?
w10_T4_005772: A hospital canteen times its serving rounds in minutes and reports them in hours. On Monday morning the freezer held 178 meals, and a delivery before lunch added 61. Early in the afternoon 21 meals arrived from another kitchen, and later that afternoon 21 more came in. In the evening 108 meals were served to patients, and a member of staff took 1 meal home. The canteen has 12 tables. How many meals are in the freezer now?
w10_T4_005780: On Monday morning a wholesaler loaded 161 boxes of tea onto each of its 7 lorries. Before lunch a small van added 61 more boxes to the fleet. In the afternoon 101 boxes were dropped at a supermarket, and a returned order put 23 boxes back on board. In the evening the factory sent out 16 fresh boxes to the lorries. The drivers share a dozen flasks of coffee between them. How many boxes of tea are on the lorries now?
w10_T4_005781: A school printed 212 exam papers and shared them equally among its 4 exam rooms. A second identical set was then delivered to the first room, making that room's pile 2 times as large. During the exam 32 papers from that pile were used by candidates. Afterwards a teacher added 50 spare papers to the same pile. How many papers are in the first room's pile?
w10_T4_005783: A bicycle shop had 66 wheels in its store, and 20 of them went back to the maker as faulty. Each remaining wheel needs 8 spokes, so the mechanic counted out that many spokes from the drawer. He used 170 spokes on repairs and later found 12 more in a toolbox. A wholesaler then bought 69 spokes from him. The spokes that were left were shared equally among the shop's 3 workbenches. The shop sells 40 bicycles a month. How many spokes are on one workbench?
w10_T4_005784: On Monday morning a garden shed held 227 seed trays. Before lunch 85 trays went out to the allotment, and during the afternoon 134 trays were sold at the gate. In the evening the trays still in the shed were shared equally among 4 greenhouses, and the gardener took charge of the one nearest the gate. On Tuesday she carried 57 more trays into that greenhouse. On Wednesday a delivery made the number of trays in it 2 times as large. How many trays are in that greenhouse now?
w10_T4_005787: A bakery weighs its flour in grams although the sacks are labelled in kilograms. On Monday the bakery had 164 tins of shortbread, and each tin was emptied into 6 paper bags for the market. The bags were shared equally among the 6 market stalls, and the stall by the church took its share. The stallholder was handed 65 more bags from the van, and she sold 167 bags during the day. A dozen paper flags decorate her stall. How many bags of shortbread does she still have?
w10_T4_005793: On Saturday morning Ines loaded 93 boxes of oranges onto her van, and each box holds 5 nets of fruit. Before noon she sold 353 nets at the town market. In the early afternoon a cafe took 20 nets from the van. Later that afternoon a customer returned 12 nets that were the wrong size. In the evening a farm gave her 66 more nets for the next day. Ines sold more nets that day than her brother Pedro did at his own stall, and the market has 48 pitches. How many nets are on Ines's van now?
w10_T4_005797: A choir counts its rehearsal time in minutes and prints it in hours on the programme. The choir has 153 songbooks, and each songbook contains 6 songs, so the librarian wrote out every song as a separate sheet. The sheets were split equally between the choir's 2 sections, and Yusuf took the tenors' pile while Elsa took a pile of the same size. Each sheet in Yusuf's pile was copied 4 times for the tour, and those copies were shared equally among the 4 coaches. Yusuf travelled on one coach, and a late arrival handed him 9 more copies. How many copies are on Yusuf's coach?
